units.source_text: 一个十三四岁的少女独自靠在石墙上打毛线。

en.t: A girl of thirteen or fourteen was leaning alone against a stone wall, knitting with wool.

units.source_text: 她穿着雪裤，还穿上高齿木屐，却没有穿袜子，可以看得见在冻红了的赤脚板上长着的冻疮。

en.t: She wore snow trousers and high wooden clogs, but no socks; chilblains could be seen on the soles of her bare feet, red from the cold.

units.source_text: 坐在旁边柴标上的一个约莫三岁的小女孩，心不在焉地拿着毛线团。

en.t: A little girl of about three, sitting on a bundle of firewood nearby, was absentmindedly holding a ball of yarn.

units.source_text: 从小女孩这边牵到大女孩那边的一根灰色旧毛线，发出了柔和的光。

en.t: A single strand of old gray yarn stretched from the little girl to the older one, giving off a soft glow.
